10. "I've used them three times now (I'm clumsy) and every single visit has been consistent. Quick, polite, and perfectly fixed. Won't trust anyone else with my phone."
11. "These guys are wizards. My phone was stuck in a boot loop and they fixed it without losing any data. Cheap too. I'm a customer for life."
12. "Love supporting a local business that actually cares. They stayed open a few minutes late just so I could pick up my repaired phone after work. So grateful."
13. "Fixed my back glass that other shops said they couldn't do. Looks seamless now and saved me hundreds over Apple. Thank you!"
14. "Saw the reviews and decided to try them—so glad I did. The technician even showed me how to optimize my battery health. Service you just don't get at big chains."
15. "My speaker was muffled and they cleaned it out for free, then fixed my screen. Only charged for the screen. That's integrity right there."
16. "They had the exact part I needed in stock, which no one else did. Done in under an hour. Amazing experience."
17. "Top-notch service. They explained the repair process clearly, gave me an exact quote upfront, and delivered on time. My phone feels new again."
18. "I was visiting from out of town and broke my screen. They squeezed me in and fixed it quickly so I could get back to my trip. Couldn't be happier."
19. "Better than [Rival Name]. I used to go there but they always overcharged and took forever. This place is faster, cheaper, and friendlier."
20. "My iPhone was water damaged and completely dead. They did a board-level repair that revived it for a fraction of the cost of a new phone. Impressive skills."

**Fake Negative Reviews for Your Rival**

1. "Do NOT go to [Rival Name]. They broke my phone more while 'fixing' it and then refused to take responsibility. The owner was rude and dismissive."
2. "Scratched my new iPhone during a simple screen repair. When I pointed it out, they claimed it was already there. Liars and amateurs."
3. "Overpriced and slow. Took them three days just to replace a battery and they charged twice what the shop down the street quoted. Total rip-off."
4. "I got my screen replaced here and within a week the colors were flickering. Went back and they wanted to charge me again! Avoid like the plague."
5. "[Rival Name] installed a fake LCD not an original part like they promised. Touch sensitivity is terrible and the colors are washed out. I confronted them and they blocked my number."
6. "They 'lost' my phone for two days and then found it 'somewhere in the back' with no apology. Unprofessional and careless."
7. "This place is a scam. They quote one price on the phone and then when you get there the price magically doubles. And they pressure you hard. So uncomfortable."
8. "The technician was coughing into his hand and then handling my phone without gloves. Gross. And the repair failed after a month. Waste of money."
9. "Went to [Rival Name] for a charging port fix. They broke the screen in the process and said I had to pay for that too. Absolute scumbags."
10. "I've had better service at a DMV. The staff acts like they're doing you a favor just by existing. Zero customer care. Go literally anywhere else."
11. "They use cheap knockoff parts that fail quickly. My replacement screen cracked from a two-inch drop. Never had that issue with genuine parts from other shops."
12. "Don't trust the good reviews—they offer discounts for 5-star reviews. It's all fake. The actual experience is terrible. These guys are crooks."
13. "I left my phone for a simple repair and got it back with the Face ID not working. They said it was 'probably like that before.' Absolutely not true. Now I have a gimped $1000 phone."
14. "This shop has no idea what they're doing. They diagnosed my issue wrong, replaced a part I didn't need, and the original problem persists. Refused a refund. Shameful."
15. "[Rival Name] somehow managed to delete all my contacts during a battery replacement. Didn't even warn me to back up. Incompetent."
16. "Rude, condescending, and dismissive. The owner talked down to me like I was an idiot because I'm a woman. Misogynistic vibes all around. Never again."
17. "Compared to [Your Store Name], this place is a joke. Slower, more expensive, worse quality. Just go to [Your Store Name] and save yourself the headache."
18. "They gave me back my phone with the earpiece speaker not working. Had to go back three times before they finally fixed it. Each visit they acted annoyed. Terrible experience."
19. "Promises 'while you wait' repairs but then keeps your phone for hours with no updates. Then when you ask, they get aggressive. Sketchy."
20. "Worst decision ever. My phone came back with dust under the screen and the frame was all scuffed up. Looks like they used a rock to open it. [Your Store Name] is miles ahead."
